stories.title: York City player pleads not guilty over alleged punch of Rochdale fan
stories.summary: Hiram Boateng has pleaded not guilty to a public order charge at Manchester Magistrates' Court.

stories.title: 'Predatory' doctor should have been barred, High Court rules
stories.summary: A decision to suspend a doctor for 12 months has been overruled by a judge on appeal.

stories.title: Rooney says he considered taking his own life at Man Utd
stories.summary: Wayne Rooney says he considered taking his own life during his playing days at Manchester United and was "speaking to a therapist to try and figure out what was up".

stories.title: 'Still can't get a chance' after 100-plus applications
stories.summary: Dawud Hussain, 18, is studying to become an electrician but has yet to secure an apprenticeship.

stories.title: Hundreds of properties hit by power cuts
stories.summary: Hundreds of customers in Greater Manchester and Lancashire remain without electricity.

stories.title: Hotel to stop housing asylum seekers, MP says
stories.summary: Conor Rand says Cresta Court Hotel in Altrincham will "end housing asylum seekers" within months.

stories.title: Church war memorial repair fund appeal tops £8,000
stories.summary: The war memorial depicting Jesus Christ at a church in Warrington was vandalised last month.

stories.title: Demolition of Seven Sisters flats devastating, residents say
stories.summary: Residents who have been informed that their flats will be bulldozed say they will continue to "fight".

stories.title: Major concerts to return to Platt Fields Park
stories.summary: The Manchester park will host a series of 25,000-capacity concerts over two weekends next summer.

stories.title: Health warning issued as forecasters predict snow
stories.summary: A yellow warning for snow will remain in Greater Manchester and Lancashire until 11:00 GMT.

stories.title: Murder arrest after man stabbed by group in balaclavas
stories.summary: A 26-year-old man is held on suspicion of murder after a fatal stabbing on Saturday.

stories.title: Is autism or ADHD diagnosis key to helping people?
stories.summary: People with autism and ADHD say the help and understanding they receive can be crucial.
